title: A travel planner
blurb: A planner hears a few preferences on a Sunday. Two weeks later it is asked about dietary needs and about spending on accommodation, words none of its memories use. It finds them by meaning, and the graph adds who they apply to.
try: What do you know about Maya?
How are Maya and Alfama connected?
Maya wants to see the tile museum

turns.user: I'm planning a trip to Lisbon in May with my sister Maya.

memories.text: You are planning a trip to Lisbon in May
Maya is coming on the Lisbon trip

turns.reply: Lovely. Lisbon in May, with your sister Maya.

turns.user: Maya is vegetarian, and I can't eat shellfish.
turns.reply: Noted: vegetarian for Maya, no shellfish for you.

turns.user: We want to stay in Alfama, and keep it under 150 euros a night.

memories.text: Stay in Alfama on the Lisbon trip
The budget for the Lisbon trip is 150 euros a night

turns.reply: Alfama, under 150 euros a night. Got it.

sessions.title: Two weeks later · a new conversation

turns.user: I'm booking dinner for our first evening. Any dietary needs I should mention?
turns.reply: Two. You can't eat shellfish [[you-shellfish]]. And Maya, who is coming with you [[maya-trip]], is vegetarian [[maya-diet]].

turns.user: Small update: Maya eats fish now, so she's pescatarian.

memories.text: Maya is pescatarian: she eats fish, but not meat

turns.reply: Updated: Maya is pescatarian now. The vegetarian note stays in memory as history.

turns.user: And we found cheaper flights, so the budget can go up to 200 euros a night.

memories.text: The budget for the Lisbon trip is 200 euros a night

turns.reply: Budget raised to 200 euros a night.
She was until today. Now she is pescatarian: fish is fine, meat is not [[maya-pescatarian]].

turns.user: How much can we spend on accommodation now?
turns.reply: 200 euros a night [[budget-200]]. It was 150 until you found cheaper flights.

turns.user: When did I tell you about the shellfish?
turns.reply: In our first conversation, on Sunday: "Maya is vegetarian, and I can't eat shellfish." [[you-shellfish]]
